verdict.rationale: Polar documents the building blocks only: payouts once the balance meets a minimum threshold, an available balance on the Finance page, full and partial refunds, and a public per-transaction fee schedule. Nothing in the evidence shows reconciliation reports tying payouts to bank deposits. Missing for 10: itemized settlement or payout reconciliation reports, per-payout fee/refund breakdowns, chargeback/dispute reporting, export of payout line items for matching bank deposits, and independent corroboration.
